summary: Registers CLI commands and provides handler functions for managing OpenClaw hook integrations.
responsibilities: Registers 'message-sent' hook command for processing OpenClaw events
Provides management commands (install, uninstall, status) for global OpenClaw hooks
Parses and validates OpenClaw hook JSON payloads from standard input
Coordinates with OpenClaw runtime to send ping signals upon receiving events

symbols.name: registerOpenClawHookCommand
symbols.summary: Registers the 'openclaw' command suite to the commander instance.

symbols.name: registerOpenClawHooksCommands
symbols.summary: Registers subcommands for installation, uninstallation, and status inspection of OpenClaw hooks.

symbols.name: handleOpenClawMessageSentHook
symbols.summary: Processes the incoming message:sent hook payload and triggers a ping.

symbols.name: handleInstallOpenClawHook
symbols.summary: Installs the OpenClaw hook files and reports status to the user.

symbols.name: handleOpenClawHookStatus
symbols.summary: Inspects and displays the current installation status of OpenClaw hooks.

symbols.name: handleUninstallOpenClawHook
symbols.summary: Removes the configured OpenClaw hook files.
